label: Bowl
depicts: Round bowl with three steam line curls rising above the rim
use_when: Use when the interface wants a hot bowl with steam marks clearly rising above it.
avoid_when: Do not use for the plain bowl when no steam should appear above the rim.

label: Bridge
depicts: Suspension bridge frame with two towers one curved line cable above deck rails
use_when: Use when the interface wants a suspension bridge with two towers and hanging cable lines.
avoid_when: Do not use for the arched bridge when the main span should be a single arch over water.

label: Bridge
depicts: Arched bridge with three top posts and two short water line marks below
use_when: Use when the interface wants an arched bridge silhouette over short water lines below.
avoid_when: Do not use for the suspension bridge when two towers and hanging cables should remain visible.

label: Briefcase
depicts: Briefcase with a top handle lid stripe and one centered clasp dot
use_when: Use when the interface wants a briefcase with a flat handle and one small clasp under the lid stripe.
avoid_when: Do not use for the lock plate briefcase when the front should show an oval lock shape.

label: Briefcase
depicts: Briefcase with a half circle handle above one oval lock plate
use_when: Use when the interface wants a briefcase with a rounded handle and an oval lock plate in front.
avoid_when: Do not use for the clasp dot briefcase when the front closure should stay small and simple.
